steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Sigh!

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: The 'Tschäggättäs' aren't letting us leave.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: They said Enciodes instructed them to make sure we stay here, supposedly for our own safety.

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: See? This is exactly as I said. He is trying to lock us in here!

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: The Great Elder is unconscious, the Saintess is yet to be coronated, and he insists the other two clans are traitors. The way I see it, he is definitely up to no good.

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: Shh... *Sigh*... Talking about this is not going to do us any good. The Great Elder has always been in charge of the Court's affairs, and now that this has come to pass... What are we supposed to do?

steps.name: Elder C
steps.text: Is this all Kjeragandr's will...?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's difficult to say whether this is what Kjeragandr wanted, but I'm sure it will pain Her heart to see you so dejected.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: G-Great Saintess!

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: We... We are simply worried...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is there something to worry about?

steps.name: Elder C
steps.text: The Great Elder's condition... and the situation surrounding the clans...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I just talked to the doctor. The Great Elder's outlook is not optimistic, but I'm sure Kjeragandr will have mercy on him given his leadership of the Vine-Bead Court for so many years. Have faith, the Great Elder will get better.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In the interim, I will take charge of all of the Court's decisions, big and small.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The Saintess was supposed take charge of Kjerag at the coronation, and the Great Elder has wanted to pass the baton to the Saintess for some time now. Given the extraordinary circumstances, what's stopping you?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Or do you elders have a better idea?

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: You're just the head maid...

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: Enough. Head Maid Kjarr has the right of it.

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: We've always had faith in the Saintess's ability, and she is willing to step forward to calm the masses. There is no better arrangement.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You needn't worry, dear elders.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Considering what had happened at the ceremony, Enciodes indeed had a reason to do as he did.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And even if Enciodes harbored ill intentions, as long as I'm here, the Vine-Bead Court will be safe.
Before, the Saintess's presence on the Holy Hunt's grounds, although brilliant, was only eye-catching.
But now, the Saintess radiates a certain aura that makes her impossible to defy.
The elders look at each other, before lowering their heads to her.
'As you wish, Saintess.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Leave us, please.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya, you were incredible.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Really. I thought you'd be disappointed after you came back from the ceremony.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Looks like I was worrying too much.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm disappointed alright.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But the last time I was disappointed, I couldn't say anything.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Back then, I had no way to fight for myself.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This time, even though I'm disappointed, I know that I have the power to make a change, no matter how little.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So I don't want to be left disappointed this time. I need to do something to stave off my disappointment.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya... You've grown up.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I wish I could've stayed a child forever. Thinking about these things all day is just too much effort...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But you're right. I've grown up.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Faith...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: *Cough*...

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Great Elder, you're awake!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Quiet down.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Quieting.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The ceremony... *cough*... What became of it? I... I remember interrogating the Browntail subject, but no more...

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: You were poisoned by Sir Arctosz. Then, Gnosis's appearance made things all the more complicated.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: In the end, Sir Arctosz and Matriarch Ratatos joined hands to take on Sir Enciodes, only for him to overwhelm them...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: That's not what I wanted to hear.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: What about the coronation ceremony? The Saintess? The transfer of powers?

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: The ceremony was cancelled... Sir Enciodes announced that it will resume once the Paleroches and the Browntails are dealt with.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Enciodes... *cough*...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Where's the Saintess?

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: She... She is in her room right now.
Little one, how does it feel to sit in a Tri-Clan Council meeting for the first time?
Great Elder... I never imagined that... the Tri-Clan Council's meetings would be so boring.

The clan leaders only talked about things that concerned their families. Every time they talk about which family will put in more effort in the annual events, they aren't interested at all. They don't care about Kjeragandr.
Hohoh, a smart one. I was right about you.
Great Elder... Did you show me this on purpose?
That's right.
Why?
Because you will one day become the Great Elder.
Then, you'll understand just what this so-called faith stands for.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: You... How long has it been since you came to the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Huh? 25 years, Great Elder.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: In those 25 years... *cough*... how do you think the Vine-Bead Court and Kjerag have changed?

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: I... Aside from all that the Silverashes brought us, I do not think there has been any significant change.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: These lands have not changed for a millennium.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The future ought to see no change either.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: *Cough*... Help me up.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: But, Great Elder, your health...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: I know my health... *cough*... better than anybody else.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: I don't have much time left.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Have the Saintess proceed to the great hall. Tell her... I must speak to her about something.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Doctor, this is the second time you've saved my rear.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I've had a problem with Enciodes ever since he came back to Kjerag and established that Karlan Trade of his.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm sure you saw it yourself when you entered Kjerag, his trade port. I can't begin to make heads or tails of it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I've used the things he brought in. They're handy. My men are using them too. I know that.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The youths working for me think I don't know what they say about him. Well, I do.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But he can't keep things going like this. He's going to drive Kjerag further and further into this fire pit.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Kjeragandr is watching from above. If we go down that path, Kjerag will be punished.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's why I've always been the first one to stand up against him, and this is what that got me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Paleroches are no fans of trickery.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And I had Valais by my side, but now...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Can I trust you?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor, Ratatos is here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz? I thought a hotheaded punk like you would've led your forces to take on Enciodes right about now.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If it wasn't for the Doctor stopping me, that's what I would be doing right now.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're... the Doctor... from Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You saved my life. Normally, I should be rewarding you somehow.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But if what you want is the house of Browntail, then I'm sorry to disappoint you.

options: You're overthinking it. I'm not a bad guy.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Well, that's about the most pleasing thing I've heard the past couple days.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You and I have never met, and yet you did all that to stoke the fire. Tell me, how am I supposed to not overthink it?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Well, whatever.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If Arctosz's here, I don't even have to guess at what it is that you want.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll be honest with you. Before your guy here found me, I was seriously thinking about surrendering to Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Are you sure I can help you?

options: If Arctosz is willing to surrender too, then I guess I don't need your help.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Paleroches will never surrender.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So...? What do you people want?

options: First off, you have already lost.
First off, I can't help you win this battle.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You don't have to spell it out to me like that.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The people are on Enciodes's side. When the ceremony ended, he even proclaimed that the 'crimes' are mine and Arctosz's alone and didn't do a thing to our territory.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He's decided Kjerag is already his.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And that's actually how things are.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Doctor, you're a smart one. What else can we do?

options: The best way we have to get ourselves out of this hole is to save the Saintess.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're right that only the Saintess can set things right.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And Enciodes's taken control of the Vine-Bead Court so that the Saintess can't say anything.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Now here's the problem—He definitely sees you coming.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Actually, he probably has all those men guarding the place so that you can walk right into the trap.

options: We can't go in through the front door, of course.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: They'll help the Saintess?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: There's a reason that Enciodes isn't mounting an attack on the other enemies.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: First, he doesn't think it's necessary.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Second, he is worried that the Doctor will help the Paleroches.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Doctor... If the Doctor's actually helping Arctosz, things are probably going to get out of hand.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This Doctor isn't taking charge of Arctosz's army to fight us, though.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: From what you have told me, this Doctor wants to stop Arctosz from being the reckless man he is and launching an all-out war. Considering that, it's not likely there will be any direct confrontation that leads to bloodshed.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I don't exactly believe in this possibility, however. The way I see it, it's not out of the question that this Doctor is trying to take control of the Paleroches and the Browntails, seeking to become Kjerag's new overlord.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The Doctor's not that kind of person.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Right. The Doctor certainly could do it, though.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I must say I'm a little flabbergasted by the appraisal that you two and Enciodes have of this person.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I can only hope you are right in that judgment.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In any case, however things end up, it's very likely that they are aiming for Mount Karlan, which is under our control, of course.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They'll need the Saintess to turn the tide of public opinion.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And if they succeed in getting the Saintess out of Mount Karlan, then all that Enciodes has done will be for naught.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Naturally, the Doctor knows that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's why we will see this Doctor here.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's ironic. In their eyes, we Silverashes are taking our own family heiress hostage.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They aren't wrong. Enya Silverash is indeed our hostage right now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you would rather I use a different turn of phrase, the Saintess has become our most important bargaining chip.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That doesn't change anything, however.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Gnosis... could you please stop provoking Matterhorn?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm helping you two face reality.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Or are you trying to tell me that you two didn't know that Enciodes had his eyes on more than just the transfer of powers?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It was never his plan to let faith govern the state.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's not to say anything negative about Enya Silverash.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm not interested in her at all. Naturally, I don't have any opinion about her.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But she became the Saintess, and she's done very well.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In that case, she will no doubt be an obstacle to Enciodes. That's all. And now things have come to this, we cannot permit anyone else on this stage to do any better than the head of the Silverash family.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I know that...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Of course I know that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This isn't a game. There are no do-overs. Let's not give ourselves any unnecessary trouble.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Monch, you're in charge of surveillance.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Good. This plan is perfect!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You sure about that...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: On the surface, we're sending our forces to raze the place to the ground, making it look like we're there to save Yucatan and attract their attention that way, to confuse them about your real plans.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You want the main force to attack them from the front.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's to let Arctosz's forces get near Mount Karlan. Your guys will also be there in the mountains to help them along.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Doesn't sound like the safest plan there is, but it seems feasible.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What about Degenbrecher? Even if you can deal with Enciodes's Tschäggättä performers, if you don't have a way to take care of that actual monster, you'll never be able to get to him.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Is this part of my job too?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You make that sound simple, but are you sure about this?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I wouldn't say sure. But I can probably keep her busy for some ten minutes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're a monster yourself, huh...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So, Doctor of Rhodes Island. How are you so sure I'll help you?

options: There isn't any part of this plan that has to involve you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You know, you kind of remind me of Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You told me all about your plan, and then you say don't absolutely need me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But I already know every last detail.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No one would let somebody who knows so much just walk away.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Whatever...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll go in your place.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus, this isn't a game.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why don't you take a look in the mirror before you say that crap, Ratatos?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're exhausted, you look pale as a ghost. Hell, you look completely out of it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How am I supposed to relax when I have someone like you there to save my husband?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I don't know what you and Enciodes talked about in that room.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But I'm not going to watch you hand the Browntail family over to him!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why are you staring at me like that? You want a fight?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You might just be right.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Fine, Doctor of Rhodes Island. Sciurus will help you with your plan in my place.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Though, to tell you the truth, I'm not holding out hope that we can get anything back from Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: All I can say is: good luck.
